This location was inside the area flooded by Hurricane Harvey in 2017 [1]. In Hurricane Harvey, the nearest gauge, Brays Bayou at Houston (3.6 mi away), peaked at 45.66 ft (major). In Tax Day Flood, the nearest gauge, Brays Bayou at Houston (3.6 mi away), peaked at 41.98 ft (minor). Gauge peaks are not a map of your street; they only show how high nearby rivers got.
- Houston Health Department focus groups with 31 residents found that cost led to long exposure to mold, and cleanup often did not follow guidance. [2]
- Caveat: this is a statistical index for the census tract, not your house. [3]
Not official guidance. In danger, call 911.
